title: The clans
description: The seven clans of Ide, what each name means, and its work.
html:
THE SEVEN

The seven uniku

UnikuMeaningRole
IdenzeThe chiefs pillar.education and healthcare; the priestly and teaching clan (Ono Idenze); the first son. The Ikala is chosen from Ono-Idenze
AkunniaFathers wealth. Nicknamed Aku.finance and law; the structural backbone. The Iyi (Holy Queen) is chosen through Ono-Akunnia
IsiomeNicknamed Kalia.agriculture and land, and manufacturing; the strategic voice as first son
Uli(no entry in the name dictionary)media, transport and logistics; art and culture. The Iyi comes from Uli. Recorded also as Ulide
OkiloWealths fame. The clan is Okilo; Udeze is not a clan name.energy, construction and real estate; military and law enforcement
OyioraFriend of the people.politics and leadership. Kept as recorded, at the authors instruction
EzemeThe wealthy have refused to do it.entrepreneurship; the Ikala lineage is found in Ezeme, Isiome and Idenze

BIG CLAN, SMALL CLAN

Uniku and ebo

A big clan is an uniku, and there are seven. A small clan is an ebo, and an ebo sits under one of the seven. The names above are the seven uniku; any house that forms later is an ebo of one of them, so the structure has room to grow without the seven ever changing.

TermWhat it is
unikua big clan — one of the seven
eboa small clan under an uniku; a subclan
ikakathe head of a clan (the authority records it as the uniku head)
